sql: SELECT dc.name, ROUND((SUM(oi.sale_price - ii.cost))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id JOIN public.distribution_centers dc ON dc.id = ii.product_distribution_center_id WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH cohort AS (SELECT id, created_at FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'),
o AS (SELECT c.id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS n FROM cohort c JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = c.id AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at >= c.created_at AND oi.created_at < c.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY c.id)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS cohort_size, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2) AS repeaters, ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort)), 4) AS share FROM o

WITH u AS (SELECT id, traffic_source FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'),
r AS (SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS rev FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT u.traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.rev,0))::numeric,2) AS rev, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(r.rev,0))/COUNT(*))::numeric,4) AS rev_per_user FROM u LEFT JOIN r ON r.user_id = u.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at))/3600.0) AS median_hours, COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.order_items WHERE status = 'Complete' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH u AS (SELECT id, DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS m FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'),
r AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS nr FROM public.order_items WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT u.m AS month, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.nr),0)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM u LEFT JOIN r ON r.user_id = u.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
